description: Legal and compliance content container for copyright, license, privacy, and terms links

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: Row alignment (sets --site-legal-justify). start and between also clip the separator that would lead a wrapped row.

structure.description: Copyright or license text (author the year as text, e.g. <time datetime="2026">2026</time>)
Legal page link (privacy, terms); always underlined
List form: a single list whose <li> children are the items (list semantics and an item count)

tokens.name: --sep-list
tokens.description: Separator text between items (default "\00B7", a middle dot); decorative, kept out of link names

tokens.name: --site-legal-justify
tokens.description: justify-content of the row (default center); start or space-between also clip the separator that would lead a wrapped row
